rationale: Cluster validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet covers t02-chinese-alias and t05-collection. The current cheat sheet only lists 8 rules (E5/E6/E7/E10-E15, W5/W6) and is missing E1-E4, E8, E16, W1-W4. Chinese-name-reference libraries hit E4 (alias targets must exist) hard; collection libraries hit E11 (asset registered) and W2/W4 (missing asset file/hash) hard. An incomplete cheat sheet causes the agent to miss pre-extraction checks even when validate later passes, and to misinterpret failures in collection patterns where the failing rule isn't surfaced.
expected_effect: Agent will pre-walk the full E1–E16/W1–W6 rule set against its buildPack output and catch E4 (Chinese-alias idMap) and E11/W2 (collection asset registration) before running `extract`, instead of relying solely on post-hoc `validate`. The pre-extraction snippet gives a deterministic sanity check that mirrors the validator's surface for the two failure-prone archetypes.
regression_risk: Rule semantics unchanged — only enumeration and emphasis changed. The pre-extraction snippet is an optional helper (commented as a sanity check) and does not replace the real validator. Slight increase in cheat-sheet length, but no content removed from passing tasks.
